pair_screen_scope: 14706 metadata comparisons; positive source claims only for explicitly checked internal class pairs. The screen is not 14706 visual identity judgments.
method: All172 units were inspected in both verified envelope and expanded context; independent raw A/B are evidence, not ground truth or a majority vote.
Each of the51 raw eligibility disagreements is explicitly retained in its record, with the specific raw limit and native locator where supplied; no reader exclusion is overridden.
Additional significant feature uncertainties in jointly eligible raw records are excluded. Joint eligibility does not promote uncertain closure or terminal direction to a resolved enum.
Every declared internal class pair was directly compared as a whole visible construction including attached bars, branches, terminals and local marks. Common body shape alone is insufficient.

Canonical profiles normalize principal connected geometry and retain minor shape/taper/texture differences in both exact raw observations. Source-profile matches outside accepted classes are deferred.
source_limits: All 307 base records and native bboxes remain immutable; 172 WHOLE records are partitioned, while all 135 unresolved physical source records remain unresolved placeholders.
All 16 frozen WHOLE overlay conflicts remain excluded; this new layer does not settle historical segmentation or identity.
FC136 remains unresolved at physical-cut limit [1640,579,1707,615]; no continuation beyond the photographed source is imagined.
Source classes are geometric candidates only. Cipher roles, letter values and cipher identity remain UNKNOWN/UNESTABLISHED; no alphabet size or claim that all marks are cipher signs is made.
Pale gaps can support a bounded target but cannot establish the historical owner of a detached mark. Any specifically competing unallocated mark blocks eligibility.

Pairs with equal normalized full-feature profiles but without an accepted direct whole-construction source comparison remain SOURCE_COMPARISON_DEFERRED. The pair screen is metadata-based outside declared internal class pairs.

Native paper texture, printed diagonal bands, thin faint contacts and dark overlaps limit closure/ownership judgments. Significant unresolved alternatives remain excluded rather than encoded as absent.
Private PNG views and their per-unit hashes remain private; shared evidence contains metadata pins and native locators, not published pixels or per-body crop hashes.

decision_cases.FC015_FC016: Both reviewed in paired source context; A/B boundary/closure limits retained; no owner inferred merely from a pale gap.

source_resolved_direction_and_attachment.FC165: Source correction: native low bend at the base extends LEFT of the oblique shaft, matching B. A describes a rightward low foot; that direction is not used in the canonical profile. The short leftward foot is visibly continuous; no independent bar or closed counter is introduced.
source_resolved_direction_and_attachment.FC163: Source correction: short top shoulder extends RIGHT, then the narrow descending part bends into a low return ending LEFT. A cap wording and B upper-bar wording describe this continuous terminal cap; no independent shaft-crossing bar is added.
source_resolved_direction_and_attachment.FC191: Source correction: long high shoulder/cap extends RIGHT and lower rounded return ends LEFT/up. Native source shows the continuous roof-neck-return and its open left middle gap; broad upper curl wording does not introduce an extra loop or branch.
source_resolved_direction_and_attachment.FC182: Native source retains TWO separate attached features: a projecting low-middle LEFT arm and a short LOW RIGHT foot, as well as two unequal upper tips. Both arm and foot are present in the canonical full profile; the generic fork outline is insufficient on its own.
source_resolved_direction_and_attachment.FC209: Native source retains the projecting low-middle LEFT arm AND a separate short LOW RIGHT foot. Two unequal upper tips and open upper recess remain; neither the arm nor foot is dropped to make a match.

negative_body_lookalikes.difference: Inclined shafts alone are insufficient: U051 has a conspicuous high transverse arm; U001 does not establish that arm and retains a small-return closure limit.

FC065 detached context dot has unresolved ownership; a two-lobe body match cannot absorb or discard it.
Open-left two-lobe candidate is distinct from enclosed-looking paired loops; FC128 central/neighboring detail remains excluded.
FC190 has long narrow descending return/counter plus unresolved upper slit; U051 has a short open low foot.
Two open lower arch bays versus one; low waved bodies cannot be matched by outline width alone.
Rounded upper lobe versus long flat upper roof/cap; an otherwise similar lower curve does not justify merging.
Overlapping base envelopes retain crescent and roof/lobe neighbor material. Visible pale separation alone does not resolve every target/mark/closure issue; both remain excluded.
One-main-arch versus double-arch source-description disagreement on FC003 remains excluded; not normalized into the supported two-arch class.
Angular low return/fork inventory versus rounded arches in the paired source descriptions; unresolved path topology cannot be discarded.
